title: F003 close-out: stopped_no_progress (2 substantive findings hand-patched)
body: Plan 3 F003 terminated stopped_no_progress after 2 rounds. iter0+iter1 implementer signed_off; iter1 auditor surfaced two real implementation_defect findings, both legitimate and hand-patched in this commit: (1) high/correctness — `dontpanic_orchestrate doctor` CLI subcommand called `jd.compute_strict_exit(results)` unconditionally, mapping validate-plans-strict WARN to exit 1 even in advisory mode. F003 acceptance requires advisory → exit 0. Fix at cli.py:1484 filters `validate-plans-strict` summary + `validate-plans-strict:*` per-plan entries out of exit computation when --validate-plans-strict is not set; strict mode still escalates correctly to exit 2. (2) medium/correctness — `dontpanic_doctor.py:1346` silently `continue`d on `no YAML frontmatter (missing leading ---)` for `docs/plans/*/plan.md`, producing false-green strict validation. The implementer's defensive comment cited 'INBOX.md sibling routed into plan_dir' but the loop only ever opens `plan.md` itself, so the silent-skip path was speculative cover for a case that doesn't exist. Fix removes the silent-skip; missing frontmatter now surfaces as parse_error like every other malformed case. Added 2 regression tests (test_plan_md_missing_leading_frontmatter_surfaces_as_finding + test_orchestrate_cli_advisory_mode_returns_0_with_warn_findings) covering both fixes. Full sweep: 2011 passed, 7 skipped under raw pytest. Sanitization clean (1278 files scanned). Operator-resolved as implementation_defect_patched.

body: The F002 cross-repo handoff blocker is resolved. The public repository `Silex-Research/agent-conventions` now exists, the local checkout uses `git@github.com:Silex-Research/agent-conventions.git`, and `master` plus tags have been pushed. The original v1.9.0 acceptance tag is present on the remote at `834780496d3b3a534bc2eeed029916fcbba0d49d`. Because DontPanic's embedded `claude/shared` mirror had already advanced to VERSION=1.10.0, the public repo was also synced forward and tagged `v1.10.0` at `024ecb614680c347bc329f3bc19be0f3a4644dcd` so the newly public contract repo is not stale relative to DontPanic. Verification: validator dispatch tests 4/4 passed, objective_contract dispatch tests 7/7 passed, remote `git ls-remote` shows master/v1.9.0/v1.10.0. The first attempted `dontpanic close` reused generic closeout filenames already owned by F003; those historical F003 artifacts were restored and F002 now records feature-specific evidence in `evidence/f002-agent-conventions-publication.md`.
